caption: The drawing depicts a single, cylindrical stoneware crock or jar with a wide mouth and thick rim, rendered in shades of brown, tan, and muted blue. The jar has two ear-shaped handles on either side close to the top, and stands upright with a slightly flared base. The surface of the crock shows variations in color, including patches of blue and lighter beige, with darker tones around the base and rim. On the upper front of the jar, there is an embossed or incised inscription that includes the text "O L & A. CADWELL & CO. HARTFORD" and a number “2” above a small shield and eagle motif. The background of the drawing is a plain, light beige color, with a faintly sketched rectangular border framing the image.
title: Churn
cluster: #19 — Ceramic Arts: Pottery, Stoneware, and Porcelain
